name: bluesky
description: Bluesky MCP server for Claude Code and AI agents. 45 tools for posting, threads, replies, timeline, search, custom feeds, lists, notifications and the social graph.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Bluesky over the AT Protocol.

There is no OAuth app to register. A handle and an app password from bsky.app/settings/app-passwords are the setup, and most reading tools work with no credentials at all.

Posting is public the moment it runs, so create_post, create_thread, delete_post and block_account refuse to run without an explicit confirmation.

identifier.title: Your Bluesky handle
identifier.description: For example alice.bsky.social. Leave empty to use the reading tools only.

app_password.title: App password
app_password.description: From bsky.app/settings/app-passwords. Never your account password.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can post, delete, follow or block.
